gameLocalization.note: Guide spelling variants are resolved using the paired Canto VII localization records. Starved and Withered, Its Not Over Yet, and the instant-kill skill name are scoped to these boss guides.

stageName.text: On the Tremendous Duel the Cinq Brought Upon Our Fixer

lead.text: A scripted encounter with a fixed team of one LCB Sinner Don Quixote. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns triggers its special sequence. Her HP cannot fall below 10; there is no need to rebuild your team or raise other Identities for a normal boss kill.

listLead.text: A duel with 1 fixed combatant, special stat bonuses, and an HP floor. There is no need to prepare a different Identity for this battle.

statNote.text: 7-06 values only. The enemy is Lv.45 with Defense Level 45. Pierce resistance is 0.5, and Lust, Gluttony, and Envy resistances are 1; other resistances are unconfirmed and shown as unknown. Only LCB Sinner Don Quixote is deployed, adjusted to Lv.45 and Uptie IV, with her base E.G.O at Threadspin IV.

skillNote.text: Listed Power is before bonuses from Poise, Speed differences, Declared Duel, and Focused Attack. The Stagger passive mentions Salut, but the actual event ends the encounter and unlocks its skill information. Do not treat it as a normal attack you must survive.

priorities.0.text: A fixed team of LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O only. Adjusted to Lv.45, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV; no other Identity or additional E.G.O is needed.

priorities.1.text: Don Quixote's HP cannot fall below 10. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns triggers a special sequence and advances the story. Do not restart because you mistake Stagger for failure.

priorities.2.text: Slots increase as 1 → 3 → 4 → 4, with a fixed skill layout. Her base E.G.O is equipped, but cannot be used because no Pride resources are available. Proceed with regular skills.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: This is the encounter's scripted progression. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns leads through the sequence into the story. There is no need to retry because you think your team is underleveled.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: E.G.O is equipped but cannot be used

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: La Sangre de Sancho is fixed in the loadout, but the necessary Pride resources cannot be obtained in this encounter. Using E.G.O is not required; proceed with your regular skills.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Clash predictions are worse than last turn

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: The enemy gains Poise and Haste, with further bonuses from Declared Duel and Focused Attack. Your Sinner also gains Clash Power Up and Bind through Foolhardy Duel, so check the current turn's predictions.

units.0.notes.0.text: The part cannot be broken. The fixed loadout prevents checking every resistance. Do not treat unconfirmed resistances as neutral.

units.0.notes.1.text: Don Quixote's HP cannot fall below 10. Stagger advances to an event; the HP floor does not also prevent Stagger.

phases.0.steps.0.text: Only LCB Sinner Don Quixote can deploy. She is adjusted to Lv.45 and Uptie IV for this encounter. Her only E.G.O is La Sangre de Sancho at Threadspin IV.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The Pride resources needed for E.G.O cannot be obtained, so do not wait to use it. Act with regular skills and advance to the special event.

phases.1.title.text: Assign skills to the additional slots

phases.1.steps.0.text: Turn 1 has one Allez. Winning the clash does not prevent its On Use Declared Duel or Poise gain.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Turn 2 uses Parry, Coup Droit, and Fente; your Sinner also has 3 slots. Match attacks and proceed using current predictions.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Taking damage grants Clash Power Up and Bind next turn through Foolhardy Duel. Speed changes as well as Power.

phases.2.title.text: Use regular skills and wait for the sequence

phases.2.steps.0.text: Turn 3 uses 2 Défensive evades, Coup Droit, and Fente. Turn 4 uses 2 Coup Droit and 2 Fente. Your Sinner has 4 slots on both turns.

phases.2.steps.1.text: At 7 Speed or more, the enemy inflicts Rupture or adds Count; at 7 Poise or more, Fente gains Coin Power too. Use the fixed hand and check each slot's prediction.

phases.2.steps.2.text: If Don Quixote becomes Staggered, continue into the event. Her HP cannot fall below 10, so there is no need to halt progression to find healing E.G.O or another Identity.

phases.3.title.text: Continue from the special sequence into the story

phases.3.steps.0.text: The finishing-move sequence ends the encounter and the story continues. Do not mistake it for a normal defeat screen.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Single Combat says it uses Salut, but the actual outcome is an event ending and unlocked skill information. Beating a normal Salut is not a requirement.

skills.0.response.text: Used on Turn 1. Declared Duel and Poise apply On Use, even if you win the clash. Include Declared Duel's Clash Power bonus when checking the next prediction.

skills.1.effects.1.text:
Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 2 Poise Count.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture.

skills.1.effects.2.text:
Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture.

skills.1.response.text: Used on Turns 2–4. Each Coin inflicts Rupture at 7 Speed or more. Winning the clash prevents those On Hit effects, but becoming Staggered still advances this encounter's special sequence.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [On Use] If at 7 Poise or more, Coin Power +2.

skills.2.effects.2.text:
Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, increase Rupture Count by 3.
[On Crit] Critical damage +50%.

skills.2.response.text: At 7 Poise or more, its maximum rises from the base 15 to 17. Check the current prediction including buffs and Declared Duel. After Coup Droit inflicts Rupture, beware of damage from added Count too.

skills.3.label.text: Information unlocked by event / outside normal progression

skills.3.effects.0.text: [On Use] If faster than the target, Coin Power +1 per 2 Speed difference (max 3).

skills.3.effects.1.text:
Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 4 Poise Count.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 1.

skills.3.effects.2.text:
Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 5 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 1.

skills.3.effects.3.text:
Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 5 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 1.

skills.3.effects.4.text:
Ⅳ[On Crit] Critical damage +100%.
[On Hit] Damage +5% per 1 Rupture on the target (max 50%).

skills.3.response.text: Mentioned in the Stagger passive, but actual progression ends the encounter through an event. You do not need to survive a normal 4-Coin attack or raise another Identity to beat it.

skills.4.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.4.response.text: Used on Turn 2. Winning can prevent next-turn Haste and Fragile. Despite its name, this is a regular Pierce attack; assign a clash rather than treating it as a Counter.

skills.5.response.text: Used twice on Turn 3. Successful evades increase next turn's Speed, but you do not need enough damage to kill him. Check the remaining Coup Droit and Fente as you proceed.

passives.0.condition.text: At Turn Start, faster than the enemy

passives.0.response.text: Higher enemy Speed also strengthens Pierce damage. The HP floor does not prevent Stagger.

passives.1.effect.text: Heal 7 SP. Gain Haste next turn based on Poise divided by 4 (max 3).

passives.1.response.text: The enemy recovers SP each turn and gains Speed through Poise. Do not reuse the opening clash prediction unchanged.

passives.2.effect.text: Use Salut. In actual progression, an event ends the encounter and unlocks Salut's skill information.

passives.2.response.text: Once the sequence begins, continue into the story. No preparation to survive a normal attack is needed.

passives.3.condition.text: Uses a skill against a slot successfully attacked last turn

passives.3.effect.text: After 1 cumulative turn of successful attacks, Clash Power +1; after 2 turns, Base Power +1; after 3 turns, Base Power +1 and Coin Power +1. Resets if no attack was made last turn.

passives.3.response.text: Repeated attacks against the same slot strengthen the enemy. Do not sum the stages into an assumed fixed bonus; check the actual prediction.

passives.4.response.text: Do not assume Panic continues next turn. Reducing the enemy's SP fully is not a victory requirement here.

passives.5.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.5.effect.text: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.response.text: A scripted encounter with a fixed team; no special team to change Panic Type is needed.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Don Quixote gains this at the start. At Turn End, gain Clash Power Up and Bind next turn per 10% of total HP lost during the encounter (each max 5).

mechanics.0.response.text: Taking damage strengthens clashes but lowers Speed. Check this as an effect based on cumulative HP lost during the encounter, not simply current HP percentage.

mechanics.1.effect.text: The inflicter gains +1 Clash Power against the marked target. On attack hit, gain 1 Haste next turn (up to 4 times per turn). Removed when inflicted on another target; replaced if another character inflicts Declared Duel.

mechanics.1.response.text: Applied by Allez On Use. For this enemy-specific skill, Haste triggers on attack hit. Do not assume every clash grants Haste.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Don Quixote's HP cannot fall below 10. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns advances to a special event.

mechanics.2.response.text: Do not treat Stagger as a normal failure. Depleting enemy HP or beating Salut is not required.

mechanics.3.effect.text: LCB Sinner Don Quixote is adjusted to Lv.45 and Uptie IV, and her base E.G.O to Threadspin IV. Slots follow 1 → 3 → 4 → 4, with a fixed skill layout each turn.

mechanics.3.response.text: This is special progression, separate from normal slot increases and skill draws. Use the provided hand without raising additional Identities.

mechanics.4.effect.text: The enemy heals a base 6 SP on Clash Win, increasing by 20% per clash from the 2nd clash onward. On Clash Lose, loses a base 2 SP, increasing by 10% per clash from the 2nd onward. Low Morale grants 2 Offense Level Up at Turn Start, 1 Defense Level Down on Clash Lose (max 3 per turn), and minimum Speed −1. Panic instead grants 4 Offense Level Up at Turn Start, 2 Defense Level Down on Clash Lose (max 6 per turn), and minimum Speed −1. The Low Morale threshold is unknown.

mechanics.4.response.text: Lower SP does not uniformly weaken the enemy. Panic resets SP to 0 at Turn End, so check next turn's state too.

warnings.0.text: The sequence after Stagger advances the story. Do not restart because you mistake it for a normal defeat.

warnings.1.text: The 10 HP floor does not prevent Stagger. Taking no damage or avoiding Stagger is not required.

warnings.2.text: Her base E.G.O is equipped, but cannot be used without obtainable Pride resources. Proceed with regular skills instead of waiting to use E.G.O.

warnings.3.text: Only some enemy resistances are confirmed. Do not assign neutral values to unconfirmed affinities.

warnings.4.text: Salut's use conditions outside the event are not fully confirmed. Do not build a strategy around triggering it at a specific enemy HP percentage.

preparation.0.text: Only one LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O are used. Adjusted to Lv.45, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV; no other Identity or additional E.G.O is needed for this encounter.

preparation.1.text: This is not a normal boss kill. Assign the fixed hand and advance to the sequence after Stagger or 4 turns.

roles.0.reason.text: The only deployment slot. Has Foolhardy Duel and an HP floor, and proceeds to the event with a fixed hand of regular skills.
